ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels across central lobe surfaces and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at edges and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields in central lobes; continuous black peripheral banding along trailing edges; dense black radial mottling originating from the central fluke junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate 35-degree internal angle; depth is approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; right lobe contains three distinct high-amplitude jagged indentations on the distal third; left lobe exhibits more frequent, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins leading to acute tips; trailing edge follows a non-linear sigmoidal sweep from the medial notch to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups (white, brown, and black) concentrated heavily on the extreme tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the white surface; primary set of parallel marks on the left lobe; multiple intersecting diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the entire visible ventral surface; heavy parasitic/barnacle clusters localized at the distal tips; jagged edge loss on the outer trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular prominent dark circular focal spot located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe white field.
